verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 116.5 (+1.4% in a day) and momentum is 43: prices are falling. 84s cost 800, 85s 2,500 and 86s 4,000. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-29T21:18:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 3,100 coins. Now 4,000. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 3,100 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 1 so far, averaging +19.8% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 800 (0.96 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,000 (0.98 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,500 (1.18 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,250 (1.48 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 86s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Sergej Milinković-Savić and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Sergej Milinković-Savić 85 Team of the week -78.4%; Leonardo Balerdi 83 Team of the week -74.1%; Victor Osimhen 86 Team of the week -64.8%; Kylian Mbappé 92 Team of the week -51.3%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Nick Woltemade SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 55.9K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
